problems.q: Critical processes live in shared spreadsheets.

faq.q: Custom software or an off-the-shelf system?
faq.a: If an off-the-shelf system fits the process, it's usually the faster path. Custom software makes sense when the process is a differentiator, when several systems need integrating, or when adapting a packaged system gets expensive. A discovery sprint helps decide.

faq.q: How much does custom software cost?
faq.a: It depends on scope and format. After a first conversation we send a written proposal with scope, timeline and budget. When the scope is still open, we start with a two-week, fixed-price discovery sprint.

faq.q: Who owns the code?
faq.a: Your company. Repositories, cloud accounts, domains and documentation are in your name from the start.

faq.q: Do I need data engineering or just a dashboard?
faq.a: If your data is already organized in one place, a dashboard may be enough. When it comes from several systems and needs preparing, data engineering is what makes the dashboard show reliable numbers.

faq.q: Does data science make sense for my company?
faq.a: It makes sense when there's a clear business question, like forecasting demand or segmenting customers, and historical data to answer it. When the data isn't organized yet, that's usually the first step.

faq.lead: What people usually ask before we start.

faq-custo.q: How much does a project cost?
faq-custo.a: It depends on scope and format. After a first conversation we send a written proposal with scope, timeline and budget. When the scope is still open, we start with a two-week, fixed-price discovery sprint.

faq-prazo.a: An MVP usually takes 8 to 16 weeks. The exact timeline is in the proposal, with deliveries every two weeks so you can follow along.

faq-ideia.q: Do I need to know which solution to buy?
faq-ideia.a: No. An idea or a clearly described problem is enough for a first conversation. The discovery sprint exists to turn that into scope.

faq-codigo.a: Your company. Repositories, cloud accounts, domains and documentation are in your name from the start, and we hand everything over in order when the contract ends.

faq-sistema.q: Can you take over a system that's already running?
faq-sistema.a: Yes. We start with a technical audit of the code, infrastructure and risks, and only then propose a plan.

faq-suporte.a: We stay with you if it makes sense: support with fixes, monitoring where it applies, improvements, new features and integrations. If you prefer, we train your team to take the system over.

faq-ia.q: Where does AI make sense in my company?
faq-ia.a: Usually where there's a lot of text, many documents or repetitive reading and triage: assistants that search your knowledge base, data extraction from documents, request classification. We start from the problem, and when a simple automation solves it, that's what we recommend.

faq-comunicacao.a: A direct channel with the team (email, Slack or WhatsApp), a short weekly meeting and a demo every two-week cycle.

faq-dados.q: How do you handle personal data?
faq-dados.a: We follow Brazil's LGPD: we collect the minimum needed, document how data is processed, and apply access control and encryption in the systems we build. When needed, we sign a data processing agreement.

faq-brasil.q: Do you work with companies all over Brazil?
faq-brasil.a: Yes. We work with companies across the country, and the team has people in different regions, including the Northeast and Belém (Pará).

faq-idioma.q: Do you work with companies outside Brazil?
faq-idioma.a: Yes, in Portuguese and English, with meetings in a time zone that works for both sides.

contact.h2: Tell us what you need to solve.
contact.lead: We reply by email within one business day with next steps.
contact.whatsappNote: For quick questions during business hours.
next: We read your message and reply within one business day.
We book a 30-minute call to understand the context.
We send a proposal or a discovery plan.

form.label: Contact form
form.name: Name
form.message: Tell us a bit about the project
form.messageHint: What problem are you solving, and by when?
form.lgpd: We use your details only to reply to this message. Read our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name@company.com.
errors.needsEmpty: Choose at least one option. If you're not sure, pick “Not sure yet”.
errors.messageShort: Write at least 20 characters so we can understand the project.

success.title: Message sent
success.body: We'll reply to {email} within one business day.

contact.sendError: Your message couldn't be sent. Try again or write to {email}.
contact.rateLimited: We've received several messages from this address in a short time. Try again in a few minutes or write to {email}.
contact.sendErrorPlain: Your message couldn't be sent. Try again in a moment.
contact.rateLimitedPlain: We've received several messages from this address in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.

privacy.description: How Systagma handles personal data sent through this site, under Brazil’s LGPD.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy

quem-somos.title: Who we are
quem-somos.body: The data controller is {legalName}, CNPJ {cnpj}, {cityUf}. Contact: {email}.

dados.title: Data we collect
dados.body: The contact form fields (name, email, company, needs, expected budget and message); technical logs kept by the hosting provider; and aggregated, cookieless visit statistics.

finalidade.title: Why we use it
finalidade.body: To reply to your request and prepare proposals.

base-legal.title: Legal basis
base-legal.body: Preliminary procedures for a contract at the data subject's request (LGPD Art. 7, V), and legitimate interest where applicable.

compartilhamento.title: Who we share it with
compartilhamento.body: Our email provider, hosting provider and Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection). These providers may process data outside Brazil.

retencao.title: How long
retencao.body: For {retention} or until you ask us to delete it.

direitos.title: Your rights
direitos.body: You can exercise your rights under LGPD Art. 18, such as access, correction and deletion, by writing to {email}.

atualizacoes.title: Updates
atualizacoes.body: This policy may change; the date of the last update is shown at the top of the page.

notFound.h1: This part of the system doesn't exist.
notFound.body: The address may have changed, or it never existed.
